verdict.rationale: Publishing source code under an open license is a fair question for a government digital service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows any IRS source code being published under any license. The closest material, the MeF schemas and WSDLs, are interface definitions rather than source, and even those are registration-gated and not publicly downloadable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
